requirements_slice.system_goal: Rerun the already-canonical Week runtime indicator slice through the live GRACE pipeline after pipeline and reviewer-routing fixes, without widening product scope.

in_scope.item: Reuse the existing shell DEV/PROD chip on /week as the only runtime-disclosure entry point.
Keep the collapsed Week chip visually compact and local to the chip area.
In non-production on /week, tapping the chip expands and collapses a small local disclosure showing Week render path, Telegram bootstrap result, and current runtime mode from existing frontend state.
Collect targeted unit, Playwright, visual, reviewer, and observability evidence for the rerun.

out_of_scope.item: New payload fields, WeekBrief contract changes, scoring changes, explainability changes, or business-logic changes.
Day screen changes or multi-surface redesign.
New top-level debug banners, separate diagnostics screens, or user-visible correlation, trace, or payload diagnostics.

use_case.summary: Re-validate the Week runtime diagnostics helper from the existing compact chip after live pipeline and reviewer-routing fixes
use_case.scenario: On /week in non-production, tapping the compact chip expands a local disclosure with Week render path, bootstrap result, and runtime mode.
Tapping the compact chip again collapses the local disclosure without changing the Week product surface.
In production, and on non-Week routes, the chip remains visually unchanged and inert and no Week diagnostics block appears.
Visual evidence shows dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-unchanged states with the Week top area remaining clean and not banner-like.
Post-test evidence records an explicit Week verdict for FLOW-TODAY-WEEK-WEEK after the targeted Week verification run.

business_invariants.invariant: The disclosure is client-local helper UI only and must not add backend requests, backend payload fields, or proxy routes.
Only render path, bootstrap result, and current mode may appear in the visible disclosure body.
Interactive behavior is limited to non-production on /week; production and non-Week routes remain inert.
Week render-path labels are derived from existing Week page states rather than new backend DTO fields or diagnostics endpoints.
Week hero, day strip, day drawer, domain, actions, explainability, deep sections, CTA, and WeekBrief contracts remain unchanged.
Rerun-2 validates pipeline execution and evidence routing; it must not silently expand the product scope of the already-approved Week runtime indicator slice.

expected_failure_handling.item: If any diagnostics source is absent, render a stable unknown or unavailable value instead of blocking /week.
If the page is between Week states, the disclosure may show loading or unknown, but it must not crash, leak raw objects, or call backend fallback endpoints.
If the shell-owned badge cannot remain route-gated to /week without altering Day or other routes, stop and escalate before widening the feature.
If no dedicated production Playwright host is available, deterministic unit proof is the minimum acceptable production-inert lane, but any existing prod-host proof should still be preserved.
If post-test review shows no-evidence-blocker or unexpected-degradation for FLOW-TODAY-WEEK-WEEK, the wave remains blocked until logs or trace evidence is explained or fixed.

known_defects.defect: This rerun exists because prior pipeline and reviewer-routing fixes needed live validation; no new Week helper-state architecture defect was found in W00.

success_criteria.criterion: The Week chip stays compact in collapsed state.
In non-production on /week, tapping the chip expands and collapses a local disclosure.
The disclosure shows render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Week render-path labels stay stable for canonical, in_progress, empty, error, auth_gate, and loading branches.
Production and non-Week routes stay visually and behaviorally unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed, dev-expanded, and prod-unchanged Week proof.
Reviewer evidence includes frontend visual proof for local containment and prod unchanged behavior.
Week observability verdict is explicit and is not no-evidence-blocker or unexpected-degradation.
